name: Joshikousei to Gohan Desu yo!
original_name: 女子校生とごはんですよ！
source:
"You want to get some eel?"
"Yeah, I could really go for that right now!"

Somehow I ended up treating this schoolgirl to some good... Watching her eat is simply enthralling.

Honestly, it made me horny...

Now we have a strange relationship where I buy her food in exchange for sex.
But no matter how hard I fuck her, she just won't stop eating!

"Mister, wait until I'm doing eating."
"You stop eating until I'm finished!"

[From the [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ126292.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English page[/url]]
translation:
“要不要去吃鳗鱼饭？”
“好呀，我正好超想吃那个呢！”

不知怎么的，我就这样请这名女高中生吃起了大餐……看着她大快朵颐的幸福模样，简直让人移不开眼。

老实说，这一幕看得我欲火中烧……

如今我们之间形成了一种奇妙的交易关系：我负责请她吃遍美食，她则用身体陪我做爱作为回报。
可无论我怎么卖力猛干，她的嘴就是一刻也不肯停下进食！

“大叔，好歹等我先把饭吃完嘛。”
“在我射出来之前，你倒是一口都别吃了啊！”
